chat.description: an open conversation between an actor and an entity — one per actor/entity pair

from.description: whose act or words it tells, where it tells someone's: the actor who finished a task or commented on it, the person who sent a text

knock.description: a nudge aimed at an entity, with the message that came with it

about.description: what it tells of, which may live in another graph

notification.description: words emitted, not said, telling whoever its deliver{to} names (a person, or a project for everyone standing in it) what happened; doc{body} holds them, and it is a thread of its own

mode.description: watch: notify this actor. mute: do not

subscription.description: one actor’s attention to one entity; mode watches or mutes it, and archived/opened marks on this row record putting away or reading its thread
